title: CVD risk assessment questionnaire item to profile mapping
description:
Maps ESPBI form 1 Questionnaire linkIds to Lithuanian FHIR profiles and related IGs. 
Human-readable narrative is in each target.comment; Questionnaire.item.definition repeats canonical StructureDefinition URIs where applicable. 
Source: linkId codes; target: profile identifiers (CodeSystem cvd-questionnaire-mapping-target).

Aligned with DSTU1 data structures.

In DSTU1, the CarePlan used inline `<goal>` elements with extensions for target values and
`<activity>` elements for lifestyle interventions. In R5:

- **Goals** are referenced via `CarePlan.goal` pointing to standalone `Goal` resources
  (or contained inline). Goal types: LDL target, BP target, BMI target, weight loss ≥5%.
- **Activities** use `CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference` for structured references
  or `CarePlan.activity.performedActivity` for completed activities.
- **Risk group** moved from DSTU1 inline Observation to an extension on CarePlan.
- **Informational text** (healthy nutrition, healthy weight, regular medication) is carried
  in `CarePlan.note` or `CarePlan.supportingInfo.display`.

target.comment: Section header. Registrar, institution, and workstation context typically use LT Base Patient, Practitioner, Organization, and PractitionerRole (not itemised in the illustrative Questionnaire). LT Base IG: https://hl7.lt/fhir/base/ImplementationGuide/lt.hl7.fhir.base

Aligns with Observation.effectiveDateTime on CVDRiskAssessmentLtCvd. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/cvd/StructureDefinition/cvd-risk-assessment-lt-cvd. Example: observation-cvd-risk-assessment-example. CVD IG: https://hl7.lt/fhir/cvd/ImplementationGuide/lt.hl7.fhir.cvd
Section header for accompanying chronic diseases; child items use CvdChronicConditionLtCvd.

Map programme text to Condition with CvdChronicConditionLtCvd (ICD-10). StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/cvd/StructureDefinition/cvd-chronic-condition-lt-cvd. Example: condition-cvd-heart-failure-example.
Section header for programme risk-factor items (RiskFactorStatusLtCvd).
RiskFactorStatusLtCvd. Example: observation-hypertension-negligible-example. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/cvd/StructureDefinition/risk-factor-status-lt-cvd
RiskFactorStatusLtCvd. Example: observation-dyslipidemia-treated-example.
RiskFactorStatusLtCvd. Example: observation-diabetes-untreated-example.

TobaccoUseLtLifestyle (LT Lifestyle). StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lifestyle/StructureDefinition/tobacco-use-lt-lifestyle. CI example: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-lifestyle/Observation-observation-tobacco-use-current-smoker-example.html

Section header for anthropometrics and blood pressure (LT Vital Signs IG). See child items for BodyHeight, BodyWeight, WaistCircumference, BloodPressurePanel. Vital Signs IG: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/ImplementationGuide/lt.hl7.fhir.vitalsigns
BodyHeight. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/StructureDefinition/body-height. CI: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-vitalsigns/Observation-observation-body-height-example.html
BodyWeight. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/StructureDefinition/body-weight. CI: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-vitalsigns/Observation-observation-body-weight-example.html

WaistCircumference. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/StructureDefinition/waist-circumference. CI: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-vitalsigns/Observation-observation-waist-circumference-example.html

BloodPressurePanel (systolic component). StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/StructureDefinition/blood-pressure-panel. CI: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-vitalsigns/Observation-observation-blood-pressure-example.html
BloodPressurePanel (diastolic component); same Observation as systolic.

Lipid panel section. Composite lab example: observation-lipidogram-example. Lab IG: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lab/ImplementationGuide/lt.hl7.fhir.lab. CI: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7LT/ig-lt-lab/Observation-observation-lipidogram-example.html
TotalCholesterolLabLt. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lab/StructureDefinition/total-cholesterol-lab-lt. Same CI lipidogram example as other lipid items.
CholesterolHdlLabLt. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lab/StructureDefinition/cholesterol-hdl-lab-lt.
CholesterolLdlLabLt. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lab/StructureDefinition/cholesterol-ldl-lab-lt.
TriglyceridesLabLt. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/lab/StructureDefinition/triglycerides-lab-lt.
Section for SCORE2 and programme risk group (CVD IG).
SCORE2 as valueQuantity (%). CVDRiskAssessmentLtCvd. Example: observation-cvd-risk-assessment-example.
RiskGroupObservationLtCvd. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/cvd/StructureDefinition/risk-group-observation-lt-cvd. Example: observation-risk-group-high-example.

Section for input/fsh/migration/mapping.md parity: concepts listed as missing in sibling IGs or as extended investigations. Rows 3–12,16–17 (BP, vitals, lipids, smoking) are covered by sibling items above.

mapping.md row 7 — BMI. StructureDefinition: https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/StructureDefinition/bmi
mapping.md row 13 — Fasting glucose. Lab: glucose-venous-lab-lt.
mapping.md row 14 — HbA1c. Lab: hba1c-lab-lt.
mapping.md row 15 — Creatinine. Lab: creatinine-test-lab-lt.
mapping.md row 15 — eGFR. Lab: egfr-lab-lt.
mapping.md row 18 — Alcohol. Lifestyle: alcohol-consumption-lt-lifestyle.
mapping.md row 19 — Physical activity. Lifestyle: physical-activity-lt-lifestyle.
mapping.md row 20 — Dietary habits. Lifestyle: nutrition-lt-lifestyle.
mapping.md row 21 — Family CVD history. Lifestyle: family-history-cvd-lt-lifestyle.
mapping.md row 22 — Referral. Base ServiceRequestLt (no example in IGs; profile only).
mapping.md row 23 — Follow-up visit. Base AppointmentLt (no example in IGs; profile only).
mapping.md row 24 — Achievement evaluation at second timepoint; use prevention Questionnaire achievement group or repeat vitals/labs/lifestyle Observations.
mapping.md row 25 — Additional chronic conditions (depression, COPD, AF, …). CvdChronicConditionLtCvd.
Section for migration already-covered table: context notes and EKG/medication/diabetes duration.
Maps to PatientLt; QuestionnaireResponse.subject typically carries the Patient. Example: patient-male-example.
Maps to PractitionerLt; QuestionnaireResponse.author. Example: practitioner-example.
Maps to OrganizationLt; use context in CarePlan/Encounter. Example: organization-example.
